configurations.name: Nuxt Frontend (promoter)
runtimeArgs: cd apps/promoter && pnpm exec nuxt dev

configurations.name: KlubHub Site (static)
runtimeArgs: PLUNK_PUBLIC_KEY=${PLUNK_PUBLIC_KEY:-pk_ci_pr_preview_only_do_not_subscribe} pnpm exec nx run site:build && python3 -m http.server 4300 --directory dist/site

configurations.name: Go API
runtimeArgs: cd api && PORT=8090 POSTGRES_HOST=127.0.0.1 POSTGRES_USER=klubhub POSTGRES_DB=klubhub POSTGRES_SSLMODE=disable POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=../secrets/dev/postgres_password S3_ENDPOINT=127.0.0.1:39000 S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:39000 S3_BUCKET=klubhub S3_ACCESS_KEY_FILE=../secrets/dev/s3_access_key S3_SECRET_KEY_FILE=../secrets/dev/s3_secret_key TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE=../secrets/dev/token_encryption_key ICAL_SECRET_FILE=../secrets/dev/ical_secret CORS_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4200 go run ./cmd/api
